description: This file defines a template class PointerSet for managing a set of non-owning, non-null pointers, including internal node structure, set operations, and iterators.

classes.name: PointerSet
classes.description: A template class implementing a set of non-owning, non-null pointers with efficient lookup and iteration.

classes.name: PointerSet::const_iterator
classes.description: An iterator for traversing the PointerSet, providing access to stored pointers.

methods.name: PointerSet(const PointerSet& other)
methods.description: Copy constructor that inserts elements from another set.

methods.name: template <typename InputIter> PointerSet(InputIter first, InputIter last)
methods.description: Range constructor to initialize set with a range of pointers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a pointer to the set; returns true if added.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is in the set.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a pointer from the set; returns true if removed.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a pointer or range of pointers into the set.

methods.name: intersection_with
methods.description: Returns a new set that is the intersection with another set.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end.
